findings.headline: The training headline hides a gender gap
findings.observation: TotalEnergies provides the closest female-to-male training-hours ratio of the three disclosing a split. Eni has the highest overall hours in that three-company subset, but the widest gender gap.
findings.implication: Ask for participation and hours by gender, not only the total training budget.

findings.headline: Hiring is moving faster than the workforce at Aramco
findings.observation: Women represent 26% of Aramco new hires against 8.2% of its workforce. That is a recruitment pipeline signal; TotalEnergies still leads current workforce representation at 36.7%.
findings.implication: Track whether the hiring mix translates into retention and promotion over subsequent years.

findings.headline: A management label can change the story by 11 points
findings.observation: Eni reports 30.8% women across senior and middle management, but 19.8% among senior managers alone. Equinor separately exposes the layers of its leadership pipeline.
findings.implication: Request leadership levels instead of relying on a single aggregate diversity measure.

findings.headline: The fatalities are outside the employee headcount
findings.observation: Across the five reports, 10 work-related injury fatalities were contractors or non-employees; none were own employees. Employee-only safety KPIs would miss all 10.
findings.implication: Keep contractor outcomes alongside employee outcomes in board and procurement reporting.

findings.headline: Selling assets can move the emissions line faster than abatement
findings.observation: Shell's net portfolio effect removed 3.4 MtCO2e from its bridge, versus 1.238 Mt from reduction activities and purchased renewable electricity. Equinor also attributes its Scope 1 decline primarily to divestments.
findings.implication: Separate portfolio change, physical operating reductions and measurement changes when assessing progress.

findings.headline: Avoided emissions and rising emissions can coexist
findings.observation: Aramco reports 1.57 MtCO2e avoided through energy-efficiency initiatives while its Scope 1+2 emissions increased from 68.5 to 72.0 MtCO2e.
findings.implication: A savings initiative answers a different question from the company's absolute emissions trajectory.

findings.headline: Credit volume is not a common currency for climate progress
findings.observation: Eni uses credits for equity targets, Shell for energy-product intensity, Aramco for corporate Scope 1+2, and Equinor for business flights. TotalEnergies' 5 Mt figure is a future annual plan.
findings.implication: Ask what claim the credit supports, when it was retired, and which emissions it offsets.

findings.headline: AI disclosures range from deployment counts to operating outcomes
findings.observation: TotalEnergies describes a portfolio of close to 100 digital solutions, half using AI. Aramco quantifies 95% less manual energy-reporting effort. Eni reports about 800 safety alerts; Equinor describes seismic interpretation in hours instead of months.
findings.implication: Benchmark evidence of deployment and operating benefit, not the number of AI mentions.

findings.headline: Revenue-normalised community spending changes the comparison
findings.observation: Aramco, Eni and Shell disclose annual community investment amounts. Dividing each by sales creates a scale-adjusted spending lens; Eni's ratio is unchanged by converting both euro inputs at the same exchange rate.
findings.implication: Pair spending intensity with programme outcomes and voluntary versus mandatory allocations.

findings.headline: Energy access links the SDGs to the core gas business
findings.observation: Eni explicitly links natural gas to SDG 7 and attributes most of its potentially avoided emissions to LNG. Aramco maps 12 SDGs across its report.
findings.implication: Assess the operating mechanism and beneficiaries behind each SDG claim, not the number of SDG icons.

checklist.topic: Credit quantity, purpose and timing (actual or plan)

method: AI-assisted reading and editorial synthesis; calculations are deterministic. Seven equally weighted disclosure topics, one point for explicit disclosure. Scores describe this reviewed source bundle, not overall sustainability. No live paid-model calls in this edition build.
